acceptance.AC1: POST /tasks accepts nonblank title, returns201 with id,title,status=todo
acceptance.AC2: GET /tasks returns stored tasks, stable id order
acceptance.AC3: create_app(database_path) preserves tasks when reopened with same SQLite file
acceptance.AC4: blank title is rejected422; SQL text is stored as data
acceptance.AC5: PATCH /tasks/{id} edits title or status: todo,in_progress,done; persists after reopening
acceptance.AC7: GET /tasks?q=...&status=... filters by case-insensitive literal title substring and valid status; combined filters use AND; ordered ids
acceptance.AC8: GET / returns self-contained HTML web UI with error recovery and aria-live
acceptance.AC9: Blank edit, empty PATCH, invalid status and malformed input return422; Unicode casefold search
acceptance.H1: GET /healthz returns HTTP 200 with JSON status: ok, app: mini-task-manager
